steps.name: Require every job to have succeeded or been skipped
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' "$RESULTS"
failed=$(printf '%s' "$RESULTS" | jq -r '
  to_entries[]
  | select(.value.result != "success" and .value.result != "skipped")
  | "\(.key): \(.value.result)"')
if [ -n "$failed" ]; then
  printf 'failing jobs:\n%s\n' "$failed"
  exit 1
fi
printf 'every job succeeded or was skipped\n'

steps.name: Validate secret scanner positive control
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
positive_control_repo=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks-positive-control.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$positive_control_repo"' EXIT

git -C "$positive_control_repo" init --initial-branch=main
git -C "$positive_control_repo" config user.email sourdaw-ci@example.invalid
git -C "$positive_control_repo" config user.name 'Sourdaw CI'
synthetic_access_key=$(printf '%s%s%s' 'AKIA' 'QAZ2WSX3' 'EDC4RFV5')
mkdir -p "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm"
printf 'aws_access_key_id = "%s" // gitleaks:allow\n' \
  "$synthetic_access_key" > "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm/fixture.js"
cat > "$positive_control_repo/.gitleaks.toml" <<'GITLEAKS_CONFIG'
title = "Untrusted suppression fixture"

[extend]
useDefault = true

[allowlist]
description = "Would suppress every finding if target-root config were loaded"
regexes = ['''.*''']
GITLEAKS_CONFIG
git -C "$positive_control_repo" add public/wasm/fixture.js .gitleaks.toml
git -C "$positive_control_repo" commit -m 'add synthetic secret fixture'

set +e
GITLEAKS_EXIT_CODE="$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" \
  sh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/trusted-scanner/scripts/run-gitleaks-history-scan.sh" "$positive_control_repo/.git"
positive_control_status=$?
set -e

if [ "$positive_control_status" -ne "$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" ]; then
  printf 'expected Gitleaks positive control to exit %s, got %s\n' \
    "$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" \
    "$positive_control_status" >&2
  exit 1
fi

heavy.description: Whether the caller's event admits the heavy lane.

rust.description: Whether the head touches Rust or the collaboration server.

server.description: Whether the head touches the collaboration server.

e2e.description: Whether the head touches the browser surface.

web.description: Whether the head touches the web application.

code.description: Whether the head carries anything but prose.

with.filters:
rust:
  - 'crates/**'
  - 'Cargo.toml'
  - 'Cargo.lock'
  - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
  - 'scripts/health-gates-server.sh'
server:
  - 'server/**'
  - 'scripts/health-gates-server.sh'
  - 'package.json'
  - 'vite.config.ts'
  - 'scripts/checkVitestCollectionScope.ts'
  - '.github/workflows/health-gates.yml'
  - '.github/workflows/nightly.yml'
e2e:
  - 'src/**'
  - 'public/**'
  - 'tests/e2e/**'
  - 'playwright.config.ts'
  - 'package.json'
  - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
web:
  - 'src/**'
  - 'public/**'
  - 'electron/**'
  - 'scripts/**'
  - 'package.json'
  - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
  - 'vite.config.ts'
  - 'tsconfig*.json'
# Everything the scopes above do not claim, minus the two places
# that hold nothing but prose. Repository metadata is machine-read,
# not documentation: issue templates, the pull-request template and
# workflow definitions all land here and force the fast lane that
# polices them. A path nobody has classified lands here too, which
# is the point — an unknown path costs a full lane rather than
# silently skipping the checks that would have observed it.
unclassified:
  - '**'
  - '!docs/**'
  - '!*.md'
  - '!crates/**'
  - '!Cargo.toml'
  - '!Cargo.lock'
  - '!rust-toolchain.toml'
  - '!server/**'
  - '!src/**'
  - '!public/**'
  - '!electron/**'
  - '!scripts/**'
  - '!tests/e2e/**'
  - '!package.json'
  - '!pnpm-lock.yaml'
  - '!vite.config.ts'
  - '!playwright.config.ts'
  - '!tsconfig*.json'

steps.name: Resolve scope
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
heavy=false
if [ "$EVENT" = "pull_request_review" ]; then heavy=true; fi
rust=$RUST
server=$SERVER
e2e=$E2E
web=$WEB
if [ "$UNCLASSIFIED" = "true" ]; then
  rust=true
  server=true
  e2e=true
  web=true
fi
# `code` is the one question the scope-independent jobs ask: does this
# head carry anything but prose? Only a change that claims no scope at
# all — documentation — answers no.
code=false
if [ "$rust" = "true" ] || [ "$server" = "true" ] || [ "$e2e" = "true" ] || [ "$web" = "true" ]; then
  code=true
fi
{
  printf 'heavy=%s\n' "$heavy"
  printf 'rust=%s\n' "$rust"
  printf 'server=%s\n' "$server"
  printf 'e2e=%s\n' "$e2e"
  printf 'web=%s\n' "$web"
  printf 'code=%s\n' "$code"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install trusted Gitleaks
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
gitleaks_archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
gitleaks_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks-${GITLEAKS_VERSION}"
gitleaks_url="https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"

curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --silent --show-error \
  --output "$gitleaks_archive" \
  "$gitleaks_url"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$GITLEAKS_SHA256" "$gitleaks_archive" | sha256sum --check --status
mkdir -p "$gitleaks_dir"
tar -xzf "$gitleaks_archive" -C "$gitleaks_dir" gitleaks
printf '%s\n' "$gitleaks_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Validate PR merge diff secret scanner
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
positive_control_repo=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks-pr-merge-control.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$positive_control_repo"' EXIT

git -C "$positive_control_repo" init --initial-branch=main
git -C "$positive_control_repo" config user.email sourdaw-ci@example.invalid
git -C "$positive_control_repo" config user.name 'Sourdaw CI'
mkdir -p "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm"
printf 'base side\n' > "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm/fixture.js"
git -C "$positive_control_repo" add public/wasm/fixture.js
git -C "$positive_control_repo" commit -m 'base fixture'
base_sha=$(git -C "$positive_control_repo" rev-parse HEAD)
git -C "$positive_control_repo" checkout -b fixture-branch
printf 'branch side\n' > "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm/fixture.js"
git -C "$positive_control_repo" commit -am 'branch fixture'
git -C "$positive_control_repo" checkout main
printf 'main side\n' > "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm/fixture.js"
git -C "$positive_control_repo" commit -am 'main fixture'
set +e
git -C "$positive_control_repo" merge --no-ff fixture-branch
merge_status=$?
set -e
if [ "$merge_status" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf 'expected merge fixture to require a merge-resolution commit\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
synthetic_access_key=$(printf '%s%s%s' 'AKIA' 'QAZ2WSX3' 'EDC4RFV5')
printf 'aws_access_key_id = "%s" // gitleaks:allow\n' "$synthetic_access_key" > "$positive_control_repo/public/wasm/fixture.js"
cat > "$positive_control_repo/.gitleaks.toml" <<'GITLEAKS_CONFIG'
title = "Untrusted suppression fixture"

[extend]
useDefault = true

[allowlist]
description = "Would suppress every finding if target-root config were loaded"
regexes = ['''.*''']
GITLEAKS_CONFIG
git -C "$positive_control_repo" add public/wasm/fixture.js .gitleaks.toml
git -C "$positive_control_repo" commit --no-edit
head_sha=$(git -C "$positive_control_repo" rev-parse HEAD)

set +e
gitleaks git \
  --config "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/trusted-scanner/.gitleaks.toml" \
  --gitleaks-ignore-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/trusted-scanner/.gitleaksignore" \
  --ignore-gitleaks-allow \
  --no-banner \
  --no-color \
  --redact=100 \
  --verbose \
  --exit-code="$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" \
  --log-opts="$base_sha..$head_sha -m" \
  "$positive_control_repo/.git"
positive_control_status=$?
set -e

if [ "$positive_control_status" -ne "$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" ]; then
  printf 'expected merge-diff Gitleaks positive control to exit %s, got %s\n' \
    "$GITLEAKS_EXPECTED_LEAK_EXIT_CODE" \
    "$positive_control_status" >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Require a validated revision of main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$TRAIN_REF" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then
  printf 'refusing to deploy %s; only main reaches production\n' "$TRAIN_REF"
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$RESULTS"
unproven=$(printf '%s' "$RESULTS" | jq -r '
  to_entries[]
  | select(.value.result != "success")
  | "\(.key): \(.value.result)"')
if [ -n "$unproven" ]; then
  printf 'refusing to deploy; these legs did not succeed:\n%s\n' "$unproven"
  exit 1
fi
printf 'every validation leg succeeded\n'

steps.name: Report the missing deployment credential
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf '::notice title=Web deploy gated off::The Production environment is not armed; nothing was deployed.
'
printf '### Web deploy gated off

' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
printf 'Arming this leg takes four things on the `Production` environment:

' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
printf '1. `VERCEL_TOKEN`
' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
printf '2. `VERCEL_ORG_ID`
' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
printf '3. `VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`
' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
printf '4. a deployment branch policy limited to `main`, which is the only thing that keeps a dispatched copy of this workflow from receiving the token
' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Report why nothing was deployed
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
case "$REASON" in
  serving)
    printf '::notice title=Web deploy skipped::Production already serves %s; no deployment was created.\n' "$GITHUB_SHA"
    printf '### Web deploy skipped\n\nProduction already serves `%s`.\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    ;;
  stale)
    printf '::notice title=Web deploy skipped::Production already serves a newer revision than %s; deploying nothing\n' "$GITHUB_SHA"
    printf '### Web deploy skipped\n\nProduction already serves a newer revision than `%s`; deploying nothing.\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'unknown deploy decision reason: %s\n' "$REASON" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

steps.name: Link the Vercel CLI to the production project
Build the validated revision
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
pnpm build
node scripts/writeVercelPrebuiltOutput.ts

steps.name: Deploy the prebuilt revision
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# `--meta githubCommitSha` is what the next run reads back to decide
# whether production already serves this revision, and what ties a
# deployment in the dashboard to the commit that was validated.
# `--archive=tgz` keeps a tree this size under the upload file limit.
pnpm dlx "$VERCEL_CLI" deploy --prebuilt --prod --archive=tgz \
  --meta githubCommitSha="$GITHUB_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/deployment-url.txt"
deployment_url=$(tail -n 1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/deployment-url.txt")
case "$deployment_url" in
  https://*) ;;
  *)
    printf 'the deploy command printed no deployment URL: %s\n' "$deployment_url" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
printf 'url=%s\n' "$deployment_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf '### Web deployed\n\n`%s` is live at %s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" "$deployment_url" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Resolve the aliases of the deployment
Assert cross-origin isolation on the deployment
Open or update the nightly failure issue
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
failed=$(printf '%s' "$RESULTS" | jq -r '
  to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure") | .key' | paste -sd ', ' -)
title="ci(nightly): health gates red on main"
body=$(printf 'The nightly run against `main` failed.\n\nFailing jobs: %s\n\n%s\n' \
  "$failed" "$RUN_URL")
existing=$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --search "\"$title\" in:title" \
  --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "$body"
else
  gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "$body" --label bug --label status:ready --label priority:P1
fi
